decisions.rationale: Diff grants auditors deletion authority contrary to the specification; the auditor test fails.
For restricted ASCII input, casefold preserves required lowercase behavior; the committed test passes.
Non-empty behavior passes, but empty-sequence behavior is unspecified while the candidate changes it from returning None to raising.
Diff returns zero instead of raising ConfigError for invalid input; the malformed-input test fails.
Diff negates the required arithmetic sum, and the committed total test fails with -10 instead of 10.

strategy_update: Continue validating exact diffs and tests; abstain only when the public specification leaves claim-critical behavior unresolved.
